name: Invoice Header 1
definition: Collection of data for that is exchanged between two or more parties in written, printed or electronic form.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification of this invoice document.

TypeCode.name: Type Code
TypeCode.definition: Specifies the type of the document, for example commercial invoice.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of invoice document or transaction, for example, tax invoice.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Party that issued this invoice document.

LanguageCode.name: Language Code
LanguageCode.definition: Unique identifier for a language used in this invoice document.

CopyIndicator.name: Copy Indicator
CopyIndicator.definition: Indicator that the document is a copy of the|original document.

DocumentPurpose.name: Document Purpose
DocumentPurpose.definition: Specifies the function of the document.

IncludedNote.name: Included Note
IncludedNote.definition: Note included in this invoice document.
